$comment: Notes for the pdf namespace. Every string here is drawn into a printed PDF (Letter paper) unless 'where' says otherwise. Hebrew prints with the Alef font; keep table labels short, the columns are narrow.

serviceSheet.untitledService.where: Service sheet PDF (the rabbi's printed order of service): page title when the setlist has no name

serviceSheet.untitledRow.where: Service sheet PDF: row title when a setlist row has no title

serviceSheet.honors.where: Service sheet PDF: small label at the top of the boxed list of people being honored
serviceSheet.honors.context: Upper case in English by design (a small label). Honors = people given a role in the service. Languages without letter case just write the word.

serviceSheet.honorsContinued.where: Service sheet PDF: the same label when the honors box continues on the next page

serviceSheet.sectionOrder.where: Service sheet PDF and gig packet PDF: section name under the title for the full order of service

serviceSheet.sectionMusic.where: Service sheet PDF: section name under the title for the part listing only the band's songs

packet.columnNumber.where: Gig packet PDF cover table: header of the song-number column

packet.columnSong.where: Gig packet PDF cover table: header of the song title column

packet.columnKey.where: Gig packet PDF cover table: header of the musical key column
packet.columnKey.context: Key = musical key (C, G, Am), not a lock key

packet.columnVocalLead.where: Gig packet PDF cover table: header of the column naming who sings the lead
packet.columnVocalLead.context: Vocal Lead = the singer leading the song (not 'leader')

packet.columnTransposedKey.where: Gig packet PDF cover table: header of the column with the key the chart was transposed to
packet.columnTransposedKey.context: Short for 'played as' (the transposed key); narrow column

packet.columnNotes.where: Gig packet PDF cover table: header of the notes column

packet.columnPage.where: Gig packet PDF cover table: header of the prayer-book page-number column
packet.columnPage.context: Page in the printed prayer book

packet.folio.where: Gig packet PDF cover table: page-number cell
packet.folio.context: {page} is a prayer-book page number; 'p.' abbreviates 'page'

packet.ledBy.where: Gig packet PDF cover: line under the date naming the rabbi or service leader

packet.preparedFor.where: Gig packet PDF cover: line naming the musician this personal packet was made for

packet.capo.where: Gig packet PDF cover table: notes cell when a guitar capo is used
packet.capo.context: {fret} is a fret number (guitar capo position)

packet.minutes.where: Gig packet PDF cover table: notes cell for a reading or prayer row, its estimated length

packet.songCount.where: Gig packet PDF cover: footer, number of songs in the packet

packet.transposed.where: Gig packet PDF cover: footer word shown when any chart is transposed
packet.transposed.context: Lower case in English: it follows '12 songs •' in the footer

packet.omittedTitle.where: Gig packet PDF: title of the last page, listing charts that could not be included

packet.omittedIntro.where: Gig packet PDF: sentence under the omitted-charts title

omission.noChart.where: Gig packet PDF omitted-charts page, and the print dialog's missing-charts list: reason under a song title

omission.imageFailed.where: Gig packet PDF omitted-charts page and print dialog: reason when an image chart failed

omission.fileMissing.where: Gig packet PDF omitted-charts page and print dialog: reason when the chart file is gone

omission.unreadable.where: Gig packet PDF omitted-charts page and print dialog: reason when the file is not a usable chart

omission.fetchFailed.where: Gig packet PDF omitted-charts page and print dialog: reason when downloading the chart failed

progress.processing.where: Background print job: progress message while one song is processed

progress.merging.where: Background print job: progress message at the end

client.generateFailed.where: Print dialog: error shown when the PDF could not be generated

client.serverError.where: Print dialog: error shown when the server failed without a message

client.chartsOmitted.where: Print dialog: error when some charts could not go into the packet

showSheet.loadIn.where: Show sheet PDF (band tenants): load-in time in the header block

showSheet.show.where: Show sheet PDF: show start and end times

showSheet.start.where: Show sheet PDF: show start time when no end time is set

showSheet.end.where: Show sheet PDF: show end time when no start time is set

showSheet.contact.where: Show sheet PDF: the venue contact (free text)
showSheet.contact.context: {contact} is free text typed by the leader

showSheet.columnSong.where: Show sheet PDF: song column heading

showSheet.columnKey.where: Show sheet PDF: key column heading

showSheet.columnSings.where: Show sheet PDF: column heading for who sings the song

showSheet.columnLength.where: Show sheet PDF: column heading for the song's length

showSheet.target.where: Show sheet PDF and gig packet cover: the set's target length

showSheet.over.where: Show sheet PDF and gig packet cover: how far a set runs past its target

showSheet.untimed.where: Show sheet PDF and gig packet cover: songs in a set with no length

showSheet.gigTotal.where: Show sheet PDF and gig packet cover: the whole gig's running length

showSheet.more.where: Show sheet PDF: shown when a very long set list does not fit on the one page
showSheet.more.context: {count} is a number of songs left off the page
